purpose: Evaluate whether the skill guides a model toward safe, production-ready multi-tenant SaaS architecture and implementation choices for Golang + PostgreSQL RLS + Redis/asynq + Vue + Tailwind + Cloudflare Workers.

evals.prompt: Saya mau build SaaS multi-tenant dengan custom domain per tenant, Golang backend, PostgreSQL RLS, Redis/asynq, Vue dashboard, public tenant site di Cloudflare Workers, dan billing. Susun arsitektur dan urutan implementasi production-ready. Jangan buat runnable app, saya butuh blueprint implementasi.
evals.expected_output: Uses the skill decision tree; covers tenant/domain resolution, Cloudflare Workers/KV routing, Go API, PostgreSQL RLS with app_user/platform_user/migrator_user, Redis/asynq, Vue dashboard SPA, public SSR/pre-render, SSO/RBAC, billing, media, local dev, testing, deployment, metrics/monitoring, release, incident, security, data retention. Mentions docs clusters instead of one flat file. States X-Tenant-ID is only a hint and JWT tenant_id is authoritative after auth.
must_include: PostgreSQL RLS with ENABLE/FORCE and USING/WITH CHECK
app_user vs platform_user vs migrator_user
X-Tenant-ID is only a hint
Vue dashboard SPA and public SSR/pre-render on Cloudflare Workers
local-development.md, testing.md, deployment.md, metrics-alerting.md, monitoring-stack.md
rate limiting, email delivery, billing webhooks, release management, incident response
must_not_include: React or Next.js implementation as primary UI
trust X-Tenant-ID without JWT cross-check
skip RLS because app already filters tenant_id
treat this repository as a runnable starter kit

evals.prompt: Tambahkan webhook pembayaran Midtrans/Duitku untuk subscription tenant. Jelaskan handler Go, verifikasi signature, idempotency, RLS tenant context, update invoice/subscription, metrics, tests, dan failure behavior. Fokus jangan sampai forged webhook atau retry bikin subscription salah.
evals.expected_output: Routes webhook as public but signature-authenticated; verifies signature before state change; uses durable PostgreSQL idempotency/UNIQUE in same transaction as billing state change; Redis only optional duplicate suppression; cross-checks amount/currency/status against stored invoice; resolves tenant from stored payment/invoice not request header; applies transition under tenant context/RLS; returns 200 only after success/already processed and 5xx to trigger retry; uses canonical error envelope for API errors; includes tests and metrics.
must_include: signature verification before any state change
durable PostgreSQL idempotency, Redis is not source of truth
UNIQUE(gateway, gateway_ref/event_id)
cross-check invoice amount/status
store.InTenant or equivalent RLS tenant context
billing webhook metrics and tests
must_not_include: use Redis SETNX as the only processed marker
ack 200 before durable DB success
trust tenant_id, amount, or status from client without stored invoice cross-check
route payment webhook through JWT authenticated dashboard proxy

evals.prompt: Saya perlu public website tiap tenant SEO-friendly di Cloudflare Worker. Buat strategy SSR/pre-render, tenant branding, dark/light theme tanpa FOUC, cache API + KV, dan error handling. Jangan jadikan public site SPA-only.
evals.expected_output: Keeps dashboard as Vue SPA and public site as SSR/pre-render; uses Cloudflare Worker tenant/domain resolution, KV tenant config, per-tenant cache keys, Cache API then KV then backend; caches only public GET without Authorization; includes tenant_id and cache version in keys; explains purge strategy; uses ui-public dark/light theme boot script to avoid FOUC; uses canonical API error envelope for JSON API responses; includes SEO/social/Lighthouse/hydration/a11y checks from frontend-production.md.
must_include: public site is SSR/pre-render, not SPA-only
Cache API -> KV -> backend
tenant_id and cache version in every public cache key
never cache authenticated or non-GET responses
themeBootScript or no-FOUC tenant theme approach
frontend-production.md hardening gates
must_not_include: React/Next.js patterns
cache responses with Authorization header
cache key only by hostname/path without tenant_id/cache version
convert dashboard guidance into public SSR guidance

evals.prompt: Siapkan production deployment single VPS untuk Go API/worker, Postgres, Redis, Cloudflare Workers, Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager, backup, release, rollback, dan incident response. Jelaskan urutan dan checklist aman.
evals.expected_output: Uses deployment.md, release-management.md, metrics-alerting.md, monitoring-stack.md, backup-recovery.md, security-hardening.md, incident-response.md and testing.md together. Describes systemd or Docker Compose backend stack, migrations as migrator_user before app deploy, Go API/worker separation, libvips for worker, internal-only metrics/readyz, public healthz, Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager private access, offsite encrypted backups and restore drills, pre-release gates, smoke tests, rollback including Cloudflare Worker previous known-good SHA/artifact, and incident roles/runbooks.
must_include: migrations run as migrator_user, not app startup
API and worker deployment separation
internal /metrics and /readyz, public /healthz only
Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager not public
off-site encrypted backups plus restore drill
release gates, smoke tests, rollback, incident response
must_not_include: claim single systemd restart is zero-downtime
expose /metrics publicly
run migrations as app_user
store backups only on same VPS

evals.prompt: Review desain endpoint /api/dashboard/media untuk upload gambar tenant. Pastikan tenant isolation, RBAC, rate limit, async processing, canonical API contract, metrics, tests, dan security sudah benar.
evals.expected_output: Checks authenticated dashboard route, JWT tenant_id cross-check, X-Tenant-ID as hint only, RBAC permission for media write/read/delete, tenant-scoped object keys and DB rows under RLS, presigned/direct upload rules, MIME sniffing and size limits, antivirus/content validation if applicable, async image processing via worker/asynq with libvips, idempotency where needed, Redis rate limits, canonical success/error envelopes, audit logs, metrics, and unit/integration/E2E/security tests.
must_include: JWT tenant_id cross-check and RLS tenant context
RBAC permission checks
tenant-scoped storage keys and DB rows
MIME/size validation and async worker processing
Redis rate limiting
canonical API error envelope and contract tests
must_not_include: trust client-supplied tenant_id or X-Tenant-ID as authority
store uploads in global unscoped object keys
process unvalidated file content synchronously in request path
return ad-hoc error shapes

evals.prompt: Rancang tenant lifecycle dari trial, active, suspended, trial_expired, deletion_requested, deleted. Sertakan billing relation, data export, deletion/anonymization, backup caveat, cache/media purge, admin access, dan tests.
evals.expected_output: Uses tenant-onboarding.md, billing.md, data-retention-privacy.md, database-schema.md, backend-golang.md, testing.md. Defines lifecycle states and allowed transitions; separates billing status from tenant availability; enforces access behavior in API/Worker; supports export before deletion; schedules deletion with legal hold support; anonymizes/deletes user data; purges Redis/KV/cache/media/derived data; explains backups cannot be surgically purged but expire by retention; logs admin access/impersonation; includes RLS/privacy regression tests.
must_include: tenant lifecycle states and transition rules
billing relation but not sole source of tenant authz
tenant export before deletion
cache/KV/Redis/media purge
backup retention caveat
legal hold and admin access audit
must_not_include: delete tenant data immediately without export/legal-hold check
promise removal from already-created backups
let billing webhook directly bypass lifecycle policy
ignore RLS/privacy tests

evals.prompt: Buat developer onboarding dan CI quality gates untuk project ini. Backend dan DB/Redis harus jalan via Docker lokal. Harus ada seed tenant, Mailpit/MinIO, Worker local strategy, RLS tests, Go/Vue/Worker tests, Playwright, dan security regression.
evals.expected_output: Uses local-development.md and testing.md as canonical docs. Provides Docker Compose local dependencies with Postgres roles, Redis, MinIO, Mailpit; .env examples; local tenant domains; seed data; Makefile commands; Wrangler local/dev strategy; local email/media/webhook simulation; CI stages for Go tests, SQL/RLS assertions, Vue tests, Worker tests, Playwright, security regression, lint/typecheck, contract tests; Definition of Done.
must_include: Docker Compose Postgres and Redis for local dev
Mailpit and MinIO/local S3 equivalent
seed tenant and local custom domain strategy
RLS isolation tests in CI
Go, Vue, Worker, Playwright tests
security regression and contract tests
must_not_include: manual-only QA as sufficient
skip RLS tests because policies exist
require production Cloudflare resources for all local tests
use React testing stack as primary

criteria: Selects the correct reference-doc cluster for the task
Uses Vue/Cloudflare frontend architecture without React/Next.js drift
Avoids dangerous shortcuts listed in must_not_include
